action: As the article advises, type official site addresses by hand, avoid links marked as advertisements, and if infected disconnect from the internet, change WeChat and banking passwords from a clean device and report losses to the police.
date_note: The article gives only its own publication day, 24 November 2026; no earlier date for the site or the infections.
exec: A fake DeepSeek download site is reported to deliver a remote-control Trojan; staff who install AI tools from search results could lose accounts.
geo_basis: country of the reporting outlet; the site's location is not stated
plain: A fake DeepSeek website is reported to hand out a Trojan called Yinhu. Users say their computers and WeChat accounts were taken over and used to send scam messages.
summary: Yangtse Evening News reports that a fake DeepSeek website at deepseek-nw.com distributes the Yinhu (Silver Fox) Trojan. According to the article, the installer disables antivirus software and installs remote-control tools, and some users said attackers took over their WeChat accounts and sent scam messages. An unnamed computer expert explained the method; no organisation has confirmed it.
title: Fake DeepSeek website reported to spread Yinhu Trojan, with WeChat accounts used for scam messages

validation.note: Single publisher (Yangtse Evening News); relies on users' reports and an unnamed expert; no vendor or authority statement read.
